# LibreOffice OOXML fixtures

These files come from LibreOffice core at commit
`de05db21dfd4708df2a39f2a77fa5a97de17102c`:

* `footnote.docx`
* `float-left.docx` (upstream `tdf116976.docx`)
* `float-right.docx` (upstream `tdf96218.docx` from `ooxmlimport/data`)
* `hyperlink.docx`
* `mixednumberings.docx`
All files except `float-right.docx` come from
`sw/qa/extras/ooxmlexport/data`. `float-right.docx` comes from
`sw/qa/extras/ooxmlimport/data`.
